title: BATON node display name
description: One definition of a legal node name, shared by the CLI, the control plane, and the tmux session layer. Duplicating this regexp is how a name gets accepted by one component and rejected by another; the constraints below come from the strictest consumer of each character class.
$comment: Lowercase alphanumeric with interior hyphens. No dots or colons: tmux forbids both in session names, and names appear verbatim in `baton-{role}-{name}` sessions. No leading or trailing hyphen, so the name survives being a Docker object name. Capped at 40 so `baton-standby-<name>--control-api` stays inside container name limits.
